payload.name: OptionClaws Options Scanner
payload.description: 交易备兑看涨期权和看跌期权
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OptionClaws scans every optionable US stock and returns ranked options trades for the strategy you ask about.  Covered calls, cash-secured puts, credit spreads, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals, straddles, strangles, and more.

Ask in plain English, like "find me high-probability iron condors on large caps with a max loss under $500" or "show me iron condors on SPY expiring in 30–45 days," and ChatGPT will run the scan and show the top candidates with return, probability of profit, greeks, and liquidity, using quotes that refresh throughout the trading day. You can also start from a built-in preset, re-run scans you've saved on OptionClaws, and look up which filters are available before you scan.

Made for options traders who want to find and compare candidate trades without clicking through chains by hand. Requires an OptionClaws account. Results are informational only and not financial advice
payload.longDescription:
OptionClaws扫描所有可交易的美国股票，并根据您指定的策略返回排名的期权交易方案。备兑看涨期权、现金保证金看跌期权、价差组合、铁鹰套利、蝶式价差、日历价差、对角线价差、跨式组合、宽跨式组合等

用日常英语提问，例如「帮我找最大亏损低于500美元的高概率铁鹰套利」或「显示SPY在30-45天后到期的铁鹰套利」，ChatGPT将运行扫描并展示顶级候选方案，显示预期收益、盈利概率、希腊字母和流动性数据，使用全天实时更新的报价。您也可以从预设方案开始，重新运行OptionClaws上保存的扫描记录，并在扫描前查看可用的筛选条件

专为期权交易者设计，无需手动点击期权链即可查找和比较候选交易。需要OptionClaws账户。结果仅供参考，不构成财务建议

payload.name: Choice Mutual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare final expense, guaranteed acceptance, and life insurance quotes from over 25 companies to find the best policy for your needs. Most policies don't require a medical exam and have no waiting period. When you're ready to apply, you simply tap a button to start the process.

In addition to the quoting function, the assistant has access to the full Choice Mutual library of articles and resources. This means you don't have to peruse through articles trying to find the information you're looking for.

Ask anything about life or final expense insurance, policy types, pricing, or even questions about the company, and the assistant can provide clear and complete answers.
payload.longDescription:
比较超过 25 家公司的身后费用保险、保证承保保险及寿险报价，找到最适合需求的保单。大多数保单无需体检，也没有等待期。准备好申请时，只需点按按钮即可开始流程。

除报价功能外，助手还可访问 Choice Mutual 完整的文章和资源库。这意味着你无需逐篇浏览文章来寻找所需信息。

无论是寿险或身后费用保险、保单类型、价格，甚至有关公司的问题，你都可以提问，助手会提供清晰完整的回答。

payload.name: Halkbank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answers your questions about Halkbank's retail, commercial, and SME banking products and services based on the content of the bank's official websites, citing its sources. You can get information in Turkish or English on a wide range of topics, from loans to cards, from Paraf to ParafLy Travel. It cannot access personal data or account information, and cannot perform customer-specific transactions.
payload.longDescription: 依据 Halkbank 官方网站的内容回答有关零售、商业和中小企业银行产品与服务的问题，并引用来源。你可以用土耳其语或英语获取从贷款到银行卡、从 Paraf 到 ParafLy Travel 等广泛主题的信息。它不能访问个人数据或账户信息，也不能执行针对具体客户的交易。

payload.name: MONVELOP
payload.description: 探索你的 MONVELOP 预算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your MONVELOP account to understand your personal budget in conversation. Ask for a monthly financial overview, a spending breakdown by envelope, recent transactions, recurring subscriptions, or a comparison between budget periods.

MONVELOP tools are read-only. They cannot create, edit, or delete financial data, initiate payments or transfers, connect a bank, or execute investments. Results are limited to your authenticated MONVELOP account and the permissions you approve.
payload.longDescription:
连接 MONVELOP 账户，通过对话了解个人预算。请求月度财务概览、按预算信封分类的支出明细、近期交易、定期订阅，或不同预算期间的比较。

MONVELOP 工具为只读，不能创建、编辑或删除财务数据，不能发起付款或转账、连接银行，或执行投资。结果仅限你已验证身份的 MONVELOP 账户，以及你批准的权限范围。

payload.name: Rydoo
payload.description: 管理你的 Rydoo 费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

Key features:
- Read and analyse spend — search expenses you own or oversee by date, status, category, group, person or trip, pull up a single expense with a link into Rydoo, find card expenses still missing a receipt, and get server-computed totals per trip, person or project.
- Process approvals — see what's waiting on you, then approve or reject an expense using your company's reject reasons. Every action is confirmed with you first and recorded under your name.
- Answer questions — expense-policy Q&A: what's reimbursable, which limits apply, and similar.
- Look up company records — find the right category, branch, group, person or trip to filter expenses by, and check your own roles, modules and currencies.
- Review trips — look up trips and bookings you own or oversee, and tie expenses back to them.
- Manage cards and wallets — list cards you hold, approve or oversee as finance, review matched and unmatched card transactions, check wallet balances, spend summaries and monthly statements, and request a virtual card with the limit you confirm. Requires the Rydoo Cards module.
- Send feedback — report a bug or request a feature straight to Rydoo.
payload.longDescription:
Rydoo MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Rydoo 账户，让你通过日常对话管理费用，无需在应用中逐项操作。使用现有 Rydoo 登录信息登录一次即可——此后，ChatGPT 只能按照你自己的角色和权限，查看和执行你在 Rydoo 中已获准访问和执行的内容。

主要功能：
- 查看和分析支出——按日期、状态、类别、群组、人员或行程搜索你本人或你负责监管的费用；调出单笔费用及其 Rydoo 链接；查找仍缺少收据的卡片费用；获取服务器计算的各行程、人员或项目合计。
- 处理审批——查看等待你处理的事项，随后使用公司的拒绝原因批准或拒绝费用。每项操作都会先征求你的确认，并以你的名义记录。
- 回答问题——解答费用政策问题，例如哪些费用可报销、适用哪些限额等。
- 查询公司记录——查找适合筛选费用的类别、分支机构、群组、人员或行程，并检查自己的角色、模块和货币。
- 查看行程——查询你本人或你负责监管的行程及预订，并将费用关联到这些行程。
- 管理卡片和钱包——列出你持有、审批或以财务身份监管的卡片；查看已匹配和未匹配的卡片交易；检查钱包余额、支出摘要和月度账单；按你确认的额度申请虚拟卡。需要启用 Rydoo Cards 模块。
- 提交反馈——直接向 Rydoo 报告问题或提出功能需求。

payload.name: Gate Info
payload.description: 加密货币市场研究数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gate Info provides public, read-only cryptocurrency research data for ChatGPT: coin profiles, market overview and spot snapshots (including batch), Gate candlesticks, order book depth, and recent trades across spot, futures, delivery, and options where supported. No login, no account balances, no order placement or fund transfers. Data is informational only and is not investment advice. News/social tools are on Gate News; documentation tools are on a separate MCP server. Production MCP URL: https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/open/info (Streamable HTTP, no auth).
payload.longDescription: Gate Info 为 ChatGPT 提供公开、只读的加密货币研究数据：币种概况、市场总览和现货快照（含批量查询）、Gate K 线、订单簿深度，以及在支持情况下覆盖现货、永续期货、交割合约和期权的近期交易。无需登录，不访问账户余额，不下单或转移资金。数据仅供参考，不构成投资建议。新闻/社交工具位于 Gate News；文档工具位于独立的 MCP 服务器。生产 MCP URL：https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/open/info（Streamable HTTP，无需身份验证）。

payload.name: Midpoint Card Prices
payload.description: 集换式及体育卡牌价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards. Ask for a card by name, set or number to get its raw (ungraded) price by condition and the graded ladder for PSA, CGC, BGS, SGC and TAG. Ask whether it is worth grading to get the PSA 9 and PSA 10 premium, net profit after grading fees, expected value by gem rate and a plain verdict. You can also see 7 to 180 days of price history, the biggest 30-day movers, rising cards that actually sell, the best cards to grade in a game or set, and priced set checklists. Every answer links to the matching page on cardcenteringtool.com. No account is needed and nothing is written.
payload.longDescription: 查询一张集换式卡牌值多少钱，以及送评评级是否划算。Midpoint 提供 1.5M+ 张 Pokémon、Magic: The Gathering、Yu-Gi-Oh!、One Piece、Lorcana、Gundam、体育（棒球、篮球、美式橄榄球、冰球、足球、摔跤、UFC、高尔夫、网球、拳击、赛车）和娱乐卡牌的当前美元市场价格。按名称、系列或编号查询卡牌，可获得按品相区分的未评级裸卡价格，以及 PSA、CGC、BGS、SGC 和 TAG 的各评级档价格。询问是否值得评级，可获取 PSA 9 和 PSA 10 的溢价、扣除评级费后的净利润、按高分评级概率计算的期望价值，以及直白的结论。还可查看 7 至 180 天价格历史、30 天内涨跌幅最大的卡牌、真正有成交的上涨卡牌、某游戏或系列中最值得评级的卡牌，以及标注价格的系列清单。每个回答都链接至 cardcenteringtool.com 上的对应页面。无需账户，不会写入任何内容。

payload.name: Mergr: Private Equity & M&A
payload.description: 私募股权公司、并购交易及买家
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mergr is a private equity and M&A research database, now available in ChatGPT. It covers 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, and 223,000+ transactions, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and 100,000+ press releases, focused on the middle market.

Ask the questions you'd put to an analyst: which PE firms would buy a $30M revenue HVAC company in Texas; who has owned a company and for how long; which sponsors are building roll-ups in a sector; which banks advised the most software deals last year. You can also paste a list of company names or websites and match them to Mergr records in one step.

Twelve read-only tools cover firm, company, and deal search; buyer, investor, and advisor matching; ownership histories; activity rankings; and roll-up tracking. Every result links to the corresponding mergr.com profile. Access requires a mergr.com membership.
payload.longDescription:
Mergr是私募股权和并购研究数据库，现已登陆ChatGPT。该数据库涵盖4100多家活跃私募股权公司、224000多家企业以及223000多笔交易，包含所有权历史、交易顾问和100000多份新闻稿，专注中型企业市场。

您可以向分析师提出问题：德克萨斯州一家年收入3000万美元的暖通空调公司可能被哪些私募股权公司收购？哪家机构曾持有某公司股权及持续时间？哪些发起人正在某个领域构建整合型业务？去年哪家银行主导了最多的软件行业交易？您也可以粘贴企业名称或网站列表，一键匹配Mergr数据库记录。

12个只读工具涵盖机构/企业/交易搜索、买家/投资者/顾问匹配、所有权历史、活跃度排名和整合型业务追踪功能。每个搜索结果均链接至对应的mergr.com档案。访问需持有mergr.com会员资格。

payload.name: Comparador de seguros BuenaIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read-only BuenaIA prototype that searches, details, and compares a catalog reconstructed from publicly available commercial product sheets (mobile, devices, home, business cyber, and digital protection). It helps identify coverage, overlaps, gaps, and profile fit, and links to the official pricing tool. It is not a Telefónica or Movistar sales channel, does not issue policies, and does not calculate personalized premiums.
payload.longDescription: BuenaIA 的只读原型，可搜索、查看详情和比较根据公开商业产品说明书重建的目录，涵盖手机、设备、家庭、企业网络安全和数字保护。它帮助识别保障范围、重叠、缺口及与个人情况的匹配程度，并提供官方定价工具链接。它不是 Telefónica 或 Movistar 的销售渠道，不签发保单，也不计算个性化保费。

payload.name: Calculadora de Autônomos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calculadora de Autônomos - Contabilizei.
Descubra como a Reforma Tributária pode impactar empresas que contratam autônomos e profissionais que trabalham por conta própria. Simule custos, compare cenários e entenda as mudanças tributárias de acordo com o seu perfil. Para as empresas, descubra qual é o custo de tempo e dinheiro na contratação de autônomos. Para quem trabalha por conta própria, veja como diferentes formas de atuação podem afetar seus custos e obrigações e entenda qual é a mais econômica.
payload.longDescription:
自由职业者计算器 - Contabilizei。
了解税制改革如何影响雇用自由职业者的企业及自雇专业人士。模拟成本、比较情景，并根据您的情况理解税务变化。对于企业，了解雇用自由职业者所需的时间和金钱成本。对于自雇者，了解不同工作形式如何影响成本和义务，并找出最经济的方式。

payload.name: Thrifle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask about any US retailer's return policy: the return window, whether returns are free, restocking fees, holiday extensions, and a grade from A+ to D-. Check whether a store price-matches, what military and student discounts it offers, what a brand gives away on your birthday, and how to cancel a subscription. Find live deals with prices and list prices, look up store credit-card terms including deferred-interest promotions, and ask whether an Amazon price is worth buying now or waiting on. Every answer includes a link to the Thrifle page it is based on. The data covers 2,250 US retailers, is verified by Thrifle's editors, and each record carries the date it was last checked. The plugin is read-only: it looks things up and never changes anything.
payload.longDescription: 询问美国任意零售商的退货政策：退货期限、是否免费退货、重新入库费用、节假日延长期，以及A+到D-的评级。查询商店是否提供价格匹配、有哪些军人和学生折扣、品牌会在你生日时送什么，以及如何取消订阅。寻找包含现价和标价的实时优惠，查询商店信用卡条款（包括递延利息促销），并询问 Amazon 的价格是否值得现在买，还是应再等等。每个回答都包含其所依据的 Thrifle 页面链接。数据覆盖2,250家美国零售商，由 Thrifle 编辑核验，每条记录都注明最后检查日期。插件为只读：仅查询信息，不会修改任何内容。

payload.name: Alvore Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alvore Finance is the workspace where financial consultants and their business clients keep the numbers an engagement runs on. With this app you can ask about a company's P&L, indicators, budget and categorized transactions for any month; review an individual client's overview, household budget and transactions; and read the consulting deliverables attached to each engagement, or publish a new one. Reads cover company and personal finance. Writes only create or update project content — a project, its briefing, an HTML deliverable and its versions — inside the client's private workspace. No tool initiates or settles a payment, transfer or purchase, and nothing the app writes is published to a public address.
payload.longDescription: Alvore Finance 是财务顾问及其企业客户保存咨询项目所需财务数字的工作空间。通过此应用，您可查询企业任意月份的损益表、指标、预算和分类交易；查看个人客户概况、家庭预算和交易；阅读各咨询项目附带的交付成果，或发布新的成果。读取范围涵盖企业和个人财务。写入操作仅在客户的私密工作空间内创建或更新项目内容，包括项目、项目简报、HTML 交付成果及其版本。没有任何工具会发起或结算付款、转账或购买，应用写入的任何内容也不会发布至公开地址。

payload.name: The Kingdom Bank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your TKB account to ChatGPT and get instant answers about your invoices — amounts, due dates, statuses and payment details — without logging into the portal.
payload.longDescription: 将TKB账户连接到 ChatGPT，无需登录门户，即可即时获得发票相关答案——包括金额、到期日、状态和付款详情。

payload.name: Análise de FIIs
payload.description: 巴西房地产投资基金研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria. Authenticated Pro users can also track their own portfolios, including holdings, dividends, valuations, and processing status. The free preview provides public fund data and indicators, while Pro unlocks the remaining tools and full analyses. The app is informational and read-only: it does not buy or sell investments, move money, or replace financial advice.
payload.longDescription: 通过自然语言研究和跟踪巴西 REITs（房地产投资基金，即 FIIs）。Análise de FIIs 整理基金价格、股息率、基本面、指标、风险、流动性、分配和报告。比较基金，并使用筛选器寻找符合条件的 FIIs。已认证的 Pro 用户还可以跟踪自己的投资组合，包括持有资产、股息、估值和处理状态。免费预览提供公开基金数据和指标，Pro 则解锁其余工具和完整分析。该应用仅供信息参考且为只读：不买卖投资、不转移资金，也不能替代财务建议。

payload.name: MetLife Pet Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore MetLife Pet Insurance through a simple, guided conversation designed to make pet insurance easier to understand. Share a few details about your dog or cat and quickly explore coverage options tailored to your pet.

Review available plan details and pricing. Whether you’re welcoming a new pet or looking for coverage for a longtime companion, the app helps you understand your options and get a personalized quote.

When you’re ready, continue with MetLife Pet Insurance to complete the next steps. Coverage, pricing, eligibility, and policy terms may vary. Chat responses may contain inaccuracies. Users should verify coverage, pricing, eligibility, and policy terms on MetLife’s website before enrollment.
payload.longDescription:
通过简单的引导式对话了解 MetLife Pet Insurance，让宠物保险更易理解。分享有关你的狗或猫的少量信息，即可快速探索适合宠物的保障选项。

查看可用方案的详情和价格。无论你是在迎接新宠物，还是为陪伴多年的伙伴寻找保障，应用都能帮助你理解选项并获得个性化报价。

准备好后，可继续前往 MetLife Pet Insurance 完成后续步骤。保障、价格、资格和保单条款可能有所不同。聊天回答可能存在不准确之处。投保前，用户应在 MetLife 网站上核实保障、价格、资格和保单条款。

payload.name: QuoteScore
payload.description: 检查维修报价是否合理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QuoteScore scores a contractor, home service or auto repair quote for pricing fairness. Paste the line items and it returns a 0 to 100 score, the fair market range for each line, and the specific problems named: a lump sum with no breakdown, labor billed past standard book time, parts marked well above retail, or an inflated shop supplies fee.

Scoring runs against roughly 14,700 regional pricing benchmarks and an archive of thousands of real quotes that people submitted to be checked, so the answer is grounded in observed prices rather than estimated. The aggregate dataset is published openly under CC BY 4.0.

Free, and no account or sign in is required. It checks price, not workmanship: it cannot tell you whether a contractor does good work, only whether the number is normal.
payload.longDescription:
QuoteScore 评估承包商、家庭服务或汽车维修报价的价格公平性。粘贴报价明细，它会返回 0 至 100 分评分、每项的合理市场价格区间，并指出具体问题：没有明细的总价、超出标准工时的人工费、远高于零售价的零件加价，或虚高的车间耗材费。

评分依据约 14,700 个地区定价基准，以及人们提交核查的数千份真实报价档案，因此答案建立在实际观察到的价格而非估算上。汇总数据集依据 CC BY 4.0 公开发布。

免费，无需账户或登录。它检查价格，不评估施工质量：它无法告诉您承包商的工作是否出色，只能判断报价数字是否正常。

payload.name: Candor Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Candor is your financial workspace for budgets, goals, recurring bills, and the decisions you want to keep. Connect your accounts on Candor, then use ChatGPT to review your finances with the records and context in one place.

Ask what changed since your last review, inspect a price increase, find a refund worth following up on, or compare spending with your budget. View cash flow, spending, budget, and recurring-payment panels. Organize transactions, confirm recurring bills, update budgets and goals, and save notes linked to the supporting records.

Candor calculates figures from your records and keeps your approved plans, notes, and action history across conversations and compatible agents. ChatGPT helps you interpret the information and decide what to do.

Requires an existing Candor account with active access. Financial accounts are connected on Candor's website. Financial-source access is read-only. Candor does not transfer money or execute investment trades.
payload.longDescription:
Candor是您的财务工作区，用于管理预算、目标、定期账单以及您希望保留的决策。
在Candor上连接您的账户，然后通过ChatGPT在一处查看记录和上下文来审查您的财务。

询问自上次审查以来的变化，检查价格涨幅，查找值得跟进的退款，或对比支出与预算。
查看现金流、支出、预算和定期付款面板。
整理交易记录，确认定期账单，更新预算和目标，并保存与支持性记录相关的备注。

Candor从您的记录中计算财务数据，并在对话和兼容代理中保留您批准的计划、笔记和操作历史。
ChatGPT帮助您解读信息并决定下一步操作。

需要现有的Candor账户并具有活动访问权限。
金融账户需在Candor的网站上连接。
金融数据源访问权限为只读。
Candor不进行资金转账或执行投资交易。

payload.name: Testfolio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Testfolio connects an eligible Testfolio account to portfolio research in ChatGPT. Backtest and compare portfolios, analyze assets, optimize allocations, evaluate tactical strategies and signals, and study retirement withdrawals, Monte Carlo scenarios, leveraged ETFs, factors, and principal components. Results explain the effective data period, assumptions, ticker provenance, key metrics, and compact summaries of large datasets. Analysis calls record account usage and may consume analysis credits. Users can explicitly create a public configuration link after a successful supported analysis. Testfolio supports historical, simulated, and hypothetical research; it does not execute trades or move money. Access requires Testfolio Max or a separate MCP grant, with tools subject to the connected account's limits.
payload.longDescription: Testfolio 将符合条件的 Testfolio 账户连接至 ChatGPT 中的投资组合研究。回测和比较投资组合、分析资产、优化配置、评估战术策略和信号，以及研究退休提款、蒙特卡洛情景、杠杆 ETF、因子和主成分。结果说明有效数据期间、假设、股票代码来源、关键指标，并为大型数据集提供简明摘要。分析调用会记录账户用量，并可能消耗分析额度。在受支持的分析成功完成后，用户可以明确创建公开配置链接。Testfolio 支持历史、模拟和假设研究；不会执行交易或转移资金。访问需要 Testfolio Max 或单独的 MCP 授权，工具受所连接账户的限制约束。

payload.name: Revestor
payload.description: 出租账目和 REPS 工时
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revestor is rental portfolio and tax-readiness software for U.S. landlords. Connect it to query live Revestor records after OAuth consent, including properties, REPS hours, expenses, and mileage. With write access, assistants can propose time logs, mileage, or unclassified expenses; proposals stay pending in Revestor AI Review until you accept them. Connector traffic does not use Gemini or Revestor AI credits. Output is records and status only, not tax, legal, or accounting advice.
payload.longDescription: Revestor 是面向美国房东的出租物业组合和税务准备软件。通过 OAuth 授权后，连接它即可查询实时 Revestor 记录，包括房产、房地产专业人士资格（REPS）工时、费用和里程。获得写入权限后，助手可提出工时记录、里程或未分类费用的建议；这些建议会留在 Revestor AI Review 中等待处理，直到您接受。连接器流量不会使用 Gemini 或 Revestor AI 积分。输出仅为记录和状态，不构成税务、法律或会计建议。

payload.name: Kintsugi AI
payload.description: 自动处理销售税与增值税
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kintsugi is an AI-powered platform that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for SaaS and ecommerce businesses, and financial firms. The Kintsugi MCP server lets you track your compliance without leaving the conversation.

With the Kintsugi MCP server, you can:

See your nexus exposure in real time, for free, across every jurisdiction where you sell

Look up registrations and jurisdiction-specific requirements

Estimate sales tax, VAT, and GST for a transaction, address, or product

Check on the status of your filings, for all jurisdictions

Look up customer records, transactions, and exemption certificates

Look up your product catalog and product tax categories

This MCP server informs your decisions rather than acting on your behalf: it doesn't file a return, register you in a new jurisdiction, or change any settings. 

Built for finance, accounting, and operations teams who need fast, accurate answers about their compliance status, whether that's confirming a nexus threshold, checking a customer's exemption history, or estimating tax on a new deal.
payload.longDescription:
Kintsugi 是一个由 AI 驱动的平台，为 SaaS、电商企业及金融机构自动处理销售税、VAT 和 GST 合规。Kintsugi MCP 服务器让你无需离开对话即可跟踪合规情况。

通过 Kintsugi MCP 服务器，你可以：

免费实时查看你开展销售的各司法辖区中的纳税关联风险

查询税务登记和各司法辖区的特定要求

估算某笔交易、某个地址或某种产品的销售税、VAT 和 GST

查看所有司法辖区的申报状态

查询客户记录、交易及免税证明

查询产品目录和产品税务类别

此 MCP 服务器为决策提供信息，不会代你采取行动：它不会提交纳税申报、在新司法辖区为你登记，或更改任何设置。

专为财务、会计及运营团队打造，快速准确回答合规状态问题，无论是确认纳税关联门槛、核查客户免税历史，还是估算新交易的税额。

payload.name: Thimble Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get real-time commercial insurance quotes, compare coverage options, and streamline underwriting workflows with Thimble. Designed for brokers, agencies, and embedded insurance experiences.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Thimble 获取实时商业保险报价、比较保障选项，并简化核保工作流程。专为经纪人、代理机构和嵌入式保险体验设计。

payload.name: Morningstar Credit Analytics
payload.description: CMBS 与 CRE CLO 监测
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Morningstar Credit Analytics brings CMBS and CRE CLO surveillance data into ChatGPT.  Ask in plain language and get answers grounded in Morningstar Credit's loan, deal, bond, property, and portfolio datasets.
payload.longDescription: Morningstar Credit Analytics 将 CMBS 和 CRE CLO 监测数据引入 ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，获取基于 Morningstar Credit 的贷款、交易、债券、房产和投资组合数据集的回答。

payload.name: Wealthfront
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin allows you to securely connect your Wealthfront cash and investing accounts with ChatGPT to get up-to-date information on your current balances and holdings.
payload.longDescription: 此插件让你安全地将Wealthfront现金和投资账户连接到ChatGPT，获取当前余额和持仓的最新信息。

payload.name: Wefunder
payload.description: 投资者与初创企业工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse Wefunder offerings using objective filters, read company pitches, disclosures, updates and questions, and inspect round terms and history. Authorized founders can review their fundraising dashboard and investor directory; syndicate managers can inspect members, investments, deals and activity. With separately granted permissions, follow or unfollow companies. Capability-gap reporting stores feedback linked to the connected account for internal review. The app cannot invest, reserve, move money, recommend investments, or guarantee returns.
payload.longDescription: 使用客观筛选条件浏览Wefunder募资项目，阅读公司推介、信息披露、动态和问题，并查看融资轮条款及历史。获授权的创始人可以查看募资仪表板和投资者目录；联合投资管理者可以查看成员、投资、交易和活动。获得单独授予的权限后，可关注或取消关注公司。能力缺口报告会存储与已连接账户关联的反馈，供内部审核。该应用不能投资、预留认购、转移资金、推荐投资，也不能保证回报。

payload.name: PublicAML
payload.description: 免费加密货币 AML/KYT 筛查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Screen and trace any Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC or TRON address for AML/KYT risk in one message. PublicAML returns an AML score (0-100), risk level, sanctions and incident exposure and source of funds. It can also follow funds forward to where they were cashed out or backward to who paid a wallet, list counterparties and recent transfers, and screen a single transaction by hash. Free, no signup, no API key. Data comes from the PublicAML Intelligence API.
payload.longDescription: 只需一条消息，即可对任意 Bitcoin、Ethereum、BSC 或 TRON 地址进行反洗钱（AML）及交易了解（KYT）风险筛查和追踪。PublicAML 返回 AML 分数（0-100）、风险等级、制裁及事件风险关联，以及资金来源。它还可顺向追踪资金到套现地点，或逆向追踪谁向钱包付款，列出交易对手和近期转账，并按哈希值筛查单笔交易。免费，无需注册或 API 密钥。数据来自 PublicAML Intelligence API。

payload.name: Equibles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Equibles gives ChatGPT direct access to US stock market data, so answers are grounded in primary sources instead of recall.

Ask for a stock price, an option chain with strikes, greeks, implied volatility and open interest, or the numbers inside a company's SEC filings. Pull 13F institutional holdings, insider transactions, congressional trades, short interest, earnings call transcripts and Federal Reserve economic series — and search the full text of filings rather than just their metadata.

90+ tools across those datasets. The free tier covers 100 requests a day with no credit card; a paid tier raises the limit. Options data is 15 minutes delayed.
payload.longDescription:
Equibles为ChatGPT提供美国股票市场数据的直接访问权限，因此回答基于原始资料，而非记忆中的信息。

可查询股票价格、包含行权价、希腊字母、隐含波动率和未平仓合约的期权链，或公司证券交易委员会文件中的数据。
获取13F机构持仓、内部人士交易、国会交易、空头头寸、收益电话会议记录和美联储经济系列数据——并可搜索文件全文，而不仅仅是元数据。

覆盖这些数据集的90+工具。
免费层级每日提供100次请求且无需信用卡；付费层级可提高限额。
期权数据延迟15分钟。

payload.name: Airwallex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring Airwallex's global financial infrastructure to ChatGPT. Orchestrate actions across your account in plain language, including the ability to set up invoices from a PO, onboard suppliers from invoices, check current cash position across currencies, and more. 
Seamlessly build and debug your integration by connecting Airwallex's documentation to ChatGPT, allowing ChatGPT to implement integration best practices.
payload.longDescription:
将 Airwallex 的全球金融基础设施带入 ChatGPT。用日常语言统筹账户操作，包括根据采购订单（PO）建立发票、根据发票登记供应商、查看不同币种的当前现金头寸等。
将 Airwallex 文档连接至 ChatGPT，顺畅构建和调试集成，让 ChatGPT 落实集成最佳实践。

payload.name: Weasel Den
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Weasel Den is a growing suite of small consumer tools (we call them weasels) under one account. The first is Receipt Weasel: price protection on autopilot. Share a receipt, as a photo or by telling ChatGPT what you bought, and it tracks each item's price. When a price falls inside the store's price-adjustment window, it tells you exactly what the store owes you and by when, so you can claim it before the window closes. Weasel Estates links to the same account. Sign in with your Weasel Den account to get started.
payload.longDescription: Weasel Den是一套不断扩展的小型消费者工具，我们称之为weasels，统一使用一个账户。首款工具是Receipt Weasel，可自动提供价格保护。分享收据照片，或告诉ChatGPT你买了什么，它就会追踪每件商品的价格。当价格在商店的价差调整期限内下降时，它会准确告诉你商店应退给你多少，以及截止时间，让你在期限结束前申请。Weasel Estates也连接到同一账户。登录Weasel Den账户即可开始。

payload.name: SplitEasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SplitEasy is a free expense ledger. After you connect your account, ChatGPT can show who you owe, who owes you, list friends and groups, preview an equal split, and add an expense in your name after you confirm. ChatGPT cannot settle up, itemize a receipt line by line, or delete your account. Works with the signed-in SplitEasy user only.
payload.longDescription: SplitEasy是一款免费的费用分类账。连接账户后，ChatGPT可显示你欠谁钱、谁欠你钱，列出好友和群组，预览均分方案，并在你确认后以你的名义添加费用。ChatGPT无法结清账目、逐行列出收据或删除你的账户。仅限已登录的SplitEasy用户使用。

payload.name: beatandraise
payload.description: 搜索 SEC 申报文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: beatandraise helps users research public companies using SEC EDGAR filings. Find companies by name or ticker, search filing text, browse filings and documents, inspect financial statements and tables, and review reported institutional holdings and insider transactions. The app retrieves public filing data; it does not execute trades or submit or modify filings.
payload.longDescription: beatandraise 帮助用户利用 SEC EDGAR 申报文件研究上市公司。按名称或股票代码查找公司、搜索申报文本、浏览申报文件及文档、查看财务报表和表格，并审阅所披露的机构持仓及内部人士交易。应用检索公开申报数据，不执行交易，也不提交或修改申报文件。

payload.name: No Trilho Finanças
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Controle suas finanças no ChatGPT com os cálculos oficiais do No Trilho. Consulte receitas, despesas, contas, dívidas e aportes; prepare alterações, revise o resumo e confirme antes de salvar. O MCP recebe somente dados financeiros estruturados necessários para cada operação.
payload.longDescription: 借助 No Trilho 的官方计算，在 ChatGPT 中管理财务。查询收入、支出、账户、债务和资金投入；准备修改、检查汇总，并在保存前确认。MCP 仅接收每次操作所必需的结构化财务数据。

payload.name: Clarifo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clarifo helps users research stock-listed companies from Nordic and US public filings. The MCP tools support company snapshots, filing search, financial statement retrieval, peer comparison, screening, valuation analysis, ownership and insider activity lookup, governance research, reporting-standards answers, and generation of Clarifo-branded visual cards from user-authored stories.
payload.longDescription: Clarifo帮助用户研究北欧和美国上市公司的公开文件。MCP工具支持公司快照、文件搜索、财务报表检索、同行比较、筛选、估值分析、所有权及内部人员活动查询、公司治理研究、报告标准答案以及根据用户原创故事生成Clarifo品牌的可视化卡片。

payload.name: AdvisorWorld Reference Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up and compare sourced U.S. state income, estate, and inheritance tax reference data with field-level citations and verification receipts. Estimate state income tax when required inputs are substantiated, compare jurisdictions, and inspect dataset versions and coverage. Missing, uncited, unverified, pending-final, and not-applicable values remain distinct and are never silently treated as zero. All tools are read-only and require no account or API key. This is reference data, not tax or legal advice.
payload.longDescription: 查询并比较有来源依据的美国各州所得税、遗产税及继承税参考数据，附字段级引用和核验凭证。在所需输入均有依据时估算州所得税、比较司法辖区，并检查数据集版本及覆盖范围。缺失、无引用、未核实、待最终确定及不适用的值始终明确区分，绝不会悄然当作零处理。所有工具均为只读，无需账户或 API 密钥。这是参考数据，不是税务或法律建议。

payload.name: ValuEdge - Stock Valuation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research stocks with ValuEdge fair value estimates, margin of safety, fundamentals, comparisons, and screening. Connect your ValuEdge account to let ChatGPT read your portfolio and watchlist, use the stock screener, and get Smart Alerts, so you can ask what your portfolio is worth, how holdings compare with fair value, which stocks deserve further research, and what has changed. ValuEdge provides read-only investment research and does not execute trades.
payload.longDescription: 通过ValuEdge的公允价值估算、安全边际、基本面分析、对比数据和筛选功能研究股票。将ValuEdge账户连接至ChatGPT，可读取您的投资组合和自选股列表，使用股票筛选器并接收智能警报，以便查询投资组合价值、持仓与公允价值的对比情况、需进一步研究的股票以及最新变动信息。ValuEdge提供只读投资研究报告，不执行交易操作。

payload.name: QuanterLab: Backtest Trading
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QuanterLab publishes walk-forward studies of investment strategies. Each study is registered before it runs, walked window by window on point-in-time data, and published with every window, figure and registration timestamp on its page. This plugin searches that library and reads a paper into the conversation, so ChatGPT answers from the study itself and links to the page. Topics so far: earnings drift, dividend capture, the Piotroski F-score, country and sector rotation, the Fama-French factors inside the S&P 500, regime classification, the overnight effect. The published papers are free to read and need no account. Signed in with a QuanterLab account, the plugin also lists your own saved backtests, screener results and projects. It never returns market data.
payload.longDescription: QuanterLab发布投资策略的前进研究。每个研究在执行前都会先注册，随后在时点数据上逐窗口进行，并在页面上发布每个窗口、图表及注册时间戳。该插件会搜索该数据库，并将论文内容导入对话中，使ChatGPT直接基于研究内容进行回答，并附上对应页面链接。目前已涵盖的主题包括：收益漂移、股息捕捉、Piotroski F分数、国家与行业轮动、标普500指数内的Fama-French因子、市场状态分类以及隔夜效应。已发布的论文均可免费阅读，无需账户。使用QuanterLab账户登录后，插件还会列出您保存的回测记录、筛选结果及项目。该插件不会返回任何市场数据。

payload.name: BTC DCA Engine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BTC DCA Engine answers one question with arithmetic instead of opinion: what would a regular buying plan have been worth?

Give it an asset, an amount and a schedule — daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly — and a start date, and it returns what you put in, what it would be worth at the last close, the profit, the simple and money-weighted returns, the units held, and end-of-year checkpoints along the way. It can compare plans side by side and rank them, and it can return the individual purchases behind any figure.

Every answer carries a link that reopens the same run in the web app, pinned to the exact data it was computed from, so a number in a conversation can be checked rather than taken on faith. Prices come from published daily closes; inflation and rate series come from the St. Louis Fed. There is no forecasting, no advice, and no trading — it reads history and does the sums.

Free with no account: seven assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq 100 and gold, and two plans per comparison. A BTC DCA Engine account covers the rest of the catalogue, larger comparisons, and the risk, inflation, lump-sum and rules-based overlays.
payload.longDescription:
BTC DCA Engine 用计算而非观点回答一个问题：如果持续定期买入，到现在会值多少钱？

提供资产、金额、频率（日、周、月或季度）及开始日期，它就会返回您的累计投入、按最近收盘价计算的价值、利润、简单收益率和资金加权收益率、持有数量，以及期间每年年末的检查点。它可以并排比较计划并进行排名，也可以返回任意数字背后的逐笔买入记录。

每个答案均附带链接，可在网页应用中重新打开同一次计算，并固定使用计算时的确切数据，让您能核查对话中的数字，而无需盲信。价格来自公布的每日收盘价；通胀和利率序列来自圣路易斯联储。不做预测、不提供建议、不进行交易——只读取历史数据并完成计算。

免费且无需账户：支持 Bitcoin、Ethereum、Solana、XRP、S&P 500、Nasdaq 100 和黄金这七种资产，每次可比较两个计划。BTC DCA Engine 账户可使用目录中的其他资产、更大规模的比较，以及风险、通胀、一次性投资和规则策略叠加分析。

payload.name: Noweir Market Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get structured stock quotes, technical indicators, trend data, symbol search, and Yahoo-derived fundamentals directly in ChatGPT. Noweir Market Data is read-only, does not connect to brokerage accounts or execute trades, and clearly labels market-data limitations.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中获取结构化股票报价、技术指标、趋势数据、股票代码搜索，以及源自 Yahoo 的基本面数据。Noweir Market Data 为只读，不连接券商账户，也不执行交易，并明确标注市场数据的局限。

payload.name: Lendflow
payload.description: 贷款工作流和融资方案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lendflow lets lending teams work their pipeline from ChatGPT. Look up applications and the businesses behind them, review the offers and funder placements attached to a deal, see which documents are still outstanding, and move a deal to its next workflow status. Users sign in with their own Lendflow account and see only the records that account already has access to.
payload.longDescription: Lendflow 让贷款团队通过 ChatGPT 管理业务流程。查询申请及背后的企业，查看关联交易的融资方案和资金提供方对接情况，了解仍缺少哪些文件，并将交易推进到下一工作流状态。用户使用自己的 Lendflow 账户登录，只能查看该账户原本已有权限访问的记录。

payload.name: Antevo Wealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Antevo Wealth account and ask about your own book in plain language: today's brief for your household, what your positions and allocation look like, total assets under management, drift against your model, correlations and concentration, real assets beyond listed securities, open compliance breaches and unread alerts, and what is on your calendar. Every answer is dated and names the source it came from. You need an Antevo Wealth account to sign in - this connector reads your own data and nothing else, and anything that would change a record describes the change and waits for your approval first.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Antevo Wealth 账户，用日常语言查询自己的资产情况：您的家庭今日简报、持仓和配置、管理资产总额、相对模型的偏离、相关性和集中度、上市证券以外的实物资产、尚未解决的合规违规及未读预警，以及日历安排。每个回答均标注日期，并注明数据来源。您需要 Antevo Wealth 账户才能登录——此连接器只读取您的数据，不读取其他数据；任何会更改记录的操作都会先描述更改内容，并等待您的批准。

payload.name: Savvy
payload.description: 面向财务 AI 的 Savant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Savvy is the Savant copilot for ChatGPT and Codex. Savant is the AI automation platform for modern finance, automating manual data work across tax and accounting processes with SOX compliance built in.
ChatGPT reasons. Savant executes and governs. Savvy connects the two, turning a conversation about a finance process into an audit-ready workflow agent running on Savant's AI control layer: a deterministic processing engine that returns the same result every cycle, human-in-the-loop review at the points that need judgment, your institutional process knowledge captured as reusable context, and governance and SOX controls that produce a full audit trail on every run.
Describe a process in plain language and Savvy plans it with you, builds it in Savant, documents it, and verifies it against your data – ready to run identically every close.
payload.longDescription:
Savvy 是用于 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的 Savant 智能副驾。Savant 是面向现代财务的 AI 自动化平台，自动处理税务和会计流程中的手工数据工作，并内置 SOX 合规机制。
ChatGPT 负责推理，Savant 负责执行和治理。Savvy 将两者连接，把围绕财务流程的对话转化为在 Savant AI 控制层上运行、符合审计要求的工作流智能体：确定性的处理引擎确保每个周期返回相同结果；需要判断的环节由人工参与审核；组织内的流程知识被记录为可复用上下文；治理和 SOX 控制在每次运行时生成完整审计轨迹。
用自然语言描述一个流程，Savvy 就会与你共同规划，在 Savant 中构建并记录它，随后用你的数据进行验证——让它在每次结账时都能以相同方式运行。

payload.name: Strata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research companies and understand market developments with Catalyst. Explore company insights, financial fundamentals, earnings, analyst updates, filings, technical indicators, economic events, industries and fund holdings. Compare stored company metrics and review source dates and links where available. You can also choose to sign in to your Catalyst app account and share selected connected brokerage accounts with ChatGPT. With your approval, Catalyst can show those accounts, the freshness of their stored holdings and a bounded list of positions. Personal quantities are shown only when their stored basis is institution-reported; converted or unverified quantities remain unavailable. Research access does not require sharing your portfolio. Data coverage and freshness vary, and this connection does not provide live quotes, account valuation, transaction history, tax lots, transfers or trade execution.
payload.longDescription: 通过Catalyst研究公司并了解市场动态。探索公司洞察、财务基本面、收益、分析师更新、文件、技术指标、经济事件、行业和基金持仓。比较存储的公司指标并查看可用的来源日期和链接。您还可以选择登录您的Catalyst应用账户，并与ChatGPT共享选定的连接经纪账户。经您批准后，Catalyst可显示这些账户、存储持仓的新鲜度以及有限的持仓列表。个人持仓仅在存储基础为机构报告时显示；转换后或未验证的持仓仍不可用。研究访问无需共享您的投资组合。数据覆盖范围和新鲜度各不相同，此连接不提供实时报价、账户估值、交易历史、税务批次、转账或交易执行。

payload.name: Caribooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Caribooks helps business owners and bookkeepers work with their QuickBooks Online companies in English or French. Review financial reports and open invoices, find expenses missing receipts, and match documents from the Caribooks document box to transactions. Save company-specific bookkeeping rules and prepare recurring tasks whose proposed changes can be reviewed in the Caribooks portal.

A Caribooks account connected to QuickBooks Online is required. Companies start with read-only access. Users enable writes separately for each company; deleting, voiding and emailing documents require explicit confirmation. Caribooks records bookkeeping entries and does not transfer money or process card charges. Features depend on the account's existing access.

Caribooks is developed by Peich Technologies Inc. and connects through Intuit OAuth. It is an independent product. The document box and Autopilot retain documents and activity as described in the privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
Caribooks帮助企业主和会计人员以英语或法语操作他们的QuickBooks Online公司。查看财务报表和未开票，查找缺少收据的费用，并将Caribooks文档箱中的文件与交易进行匹配。保存公司特定的记账规则，并准备可于Caribooks门户中审核的重复性任务。

需要连接QuickBooks Online的Caribooks账户。公司初始访问权限为只读。用户需为每家公司单独启用写入权限；删除、作废和发送文件需经过明确确认。Caribooks记录记账分录，不转移资金或处理信用卡收费。功能表现取决于账户的现有权限。

Caribooks由Peich Technologies Inc.开发，通过Intuit OAuth连接。该产品为独立开发。文档箱和Autopilot功能会根据隐私政策保留文件和操作记录。

payload.name: Finara Personal Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Finara helps users track account balances, record income and expenses, manage budget limits, transfer funds between accounts, and review financial analytics through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Finara 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 跟踪账户余额、记录收入和费用、管理预算限额、在账户之间转移资金，以及查看财务分析。

payload.name: Ask Gina
payload.description: 监控加密资产与预测市场
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask Gina is a research assistant for crypto, prediction markets, perpetuals, and equities. Use it to fetch real-time prices and historical data for tokens, Hyperliquid markets, and Polymarket prediction markets, and to analyze your Gina wallet, positions, and accounts. Gina cannot place trades or transfer assets inside ChatGPT or Codex.
payload.longDescription: Ask Gina 是加密资产、预测市场、永续合约和股票的研究助手。使用它获取代币、Hyperliquid 市场和 Polymarket 预测市场的实时价格及历史数据，并分析 Gina 钱包、持仓和账户。Gina 无法在 ChatGPT 或 Codex 内下单或转移资产。

payload.name: Distill Markets
payload.description: 可核验的 SEC 申报数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Distill Markets gives ChatGPT direct access to US SEC filing data, served exactly as filed and traceable to the EDGAR accession that stated each number.

What it covers:
- Fundamentals from 10-K and 10-Q XBRL: latest values, up to 20 years of history, financial ratios, and a bring-your-own-price valuation panel.
- Point-in-time views: what was knowable on a past date, every version of a fact across filings, and material revisions, for restatement-aware research and backtests without lookahead.
- Ownership: 13F institutional holders and manager portfolios, Schedule 13D/13G blockholders, and Form 4 insider transactions.
- Filings and events: recent SEC filings, 8-K item events, and a delta feed for agent loops.
- Context: 16 government macro series and sector capital-cycle aggregates.
- Pre-2009 annual fundamentals parsed from text filings (FY1995 to FY2009), kept separate from the XBRL record and served with per-fact provenance.

Every tool is read-only. Responses carry the accession number, filing date and XBRL concept behind each value, so any figure can be checked against the SEC document. The server states no opinions and gives no investment advice: it reports what the filer said and how it reconciles.

Coverage is US domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers. Figures are in the filer's reporting currency, never converted.

A free account covers most tools. Analyst and Pro plans add depth: full ownership lists, point-in-time detail, cross-ticker comparison and the pre-2009 corpus.
payload.longDescription:
Distill Markets 让 ChatGPT 直接访问美国 SEC 申报数据，按原始申报内容提供，并可追溯到载明每项数字的 EDGAR 申报编号。

覆盖内容：
- 来自 10-K 和 10-Q XBRL 的基本面数据：最新数值、最长 20 年的历史、财务比率，以及可自行输入价格的估值面板。
- 时点视图：过去某个日期当时可知的信息、同一数据事实在各次申报中的所有版本及重大修订，支持考虑财务重述的研究和不含前视偏差的回测。
- 所有权：13F 机构持有人及管理人投资组合、Schedule 13D/13G 大额持有人，以及 Form 4 内部人士交易。
- 申报和事件：近期 SEC 申报、8-K 项目事件，以及供智能体循环使用的增量数据流。
- 背景信息：16 个政府宏观数据序列和行业资本周期汇总数据。
- 从文本申报文件解析的 2009 年之前年度基本面数据（FY1995 至 FY2009），与 XBRL 记录分开保存，并为每项数据提供来源溯源信息。

每个工具均为只读。响应附有每个数值对应的申报编号、申报日期和 XBRL 概念，因此任何数字都可对照 SEC 文件核验。服务器不发表意见，也不提供投资建议：它报告申报者披露的内容及其勾稽核对关系。

覆盖范围为提交 10-K 和 10-Q 的美国本土申报主体。数字均使用申报主体的报告币种，绝不换算。

免费账户可使用大多数工具。Analyst 和 Pro 套餐提供更深入的内容：完整所有权名单、时点详情、跨证券代码比较，以及 2009 年之前的资料库。

payload.name: BankPilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BankPilot watches a user's bank accounts for recurring payments (rent, salary, insurance, utilities) and flags what is overdue, missing or off-amount. Connected to ChatGPT it answers, read-only, questions such as 'Welche Zahlungen sind ausstehend?', 'Show me the payments to TK', 'Zeige mir die letzten 3 Zahlungen von goldgas', 'Welche Regeln habe ich?' and 'Muss ich eine Bankverbindung erneuern?'. Answers come from the user's own transaction history, monitoring rules and bank-connection status; the app never moves money, changes rules or stores bank credentials.
payload.longDescription: BankPilot 监测用户银行账户中的周期性收付款（租金、工资、保险、水电等公共事业费用），并标记逾期、缺失或金额不符的项目。连接到 ChatGPT 后，它以只读方式回答“哪些款项尚未支付？”“显示支付给 TK 的款项”“显示 goldgas 的最近 3 笔付款”“我有哪些规则？”以及“我是否需要重新连接某个银行账户？”等问题。答案来自用户自己的交易历史、监控规则和银行连接状态；应用绝不转移资金、更改规则或存储银行凭据。

payload.name: Vega Options
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
VEGA Options helps active options traders analyze strategy risk, review options market structure, and explore possible trade setups using tools for gamma exposure, open interest, volatility zones, risk/reward charts, portfolio tracking, and AI explanations.

Use VEGA to better understand how an options strategy may behave before entering a trade, compare possible outcomes, and build a more structured trading plan.

Not financial advice. Trading involves risk.
payload.longDescription:
VEGA Options帮助活跃的期权交易者分析策略风险、查看期权市场结构，并借助Gamma敞口、未平仓量、波动率区间、风险收益图、投资组合追踪和AI解释等工具，探索可能的交易布局。

使用VEGA在入场交易前更好地了解期权策略可能的表现、比较可能结果，并制定更有条理的交易计划。

不构成财务建议。交易涉及风险。

payload.name: Awaken Tax
payload.description: 管理加密货币税务记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Awaken Tax helps users inspect cryptocurrency transactions, accounts, portfolios, tax lots, reports, and reconciliation data; correct private tax records; and generate tax reports through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Awaken Tax 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看加密货币交易、账户、投资组合、税务批次、报告和对账数据，更正私人税务记录，并生成税务报告。

payload.name: FinLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FinLens helps users research Vietnam's listed equities and financial markets in ChatGPT. It retrieves company, price, and intraday data; compares financial statements, peers, and valuation; and analyzes flows, technical signals, funds, bonds, warrants, dividends, macro data, news, and broker research. It is informational research only and does not execute trades or provide personalized investment advice.
payload.longDescription: FinLens 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中研究越南上市股票及金融市场。它获取公司、价格和盘中数据，比较财务报表、同业和估值，并分析资金流、技术信号、基金、债券、权证、股息、宏观数据、新闻和券商研究。它仅用于信息研究，不执行交易，也不提供个性化投资建议。

payload.name: Fin3000
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fin3000 verbindet ChatGPT per OAuth mit der Buchhaltung eines deutschen Unternehmens. Nutzer können Kunden, Belege, offene Posten, Banktransaktionen, Journal, UStVA-Status und BWA abfragen. Kunden, Rechnungsentwürfe und einzelne Kontierungen werden nur nach Vorschau und ausdrücklicher Bestätigung angelegt oder geändert.
payload.longDescription: Fin3000 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 连接到德国企业的会计系统。用户可以查询客户、凭证、未结清项目、银行交易、会计日记账、增值税预申报（UStVA）状态和经营分析报告（BWA）。只有在预览并明确确认后，才会创建或修改客户、发票草稿和单项科目分配。

payload.name: SAHMK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Saudi Exchange market data directly in ChatGPT using your SAHMK account. Retrieve stock quotes, company information, market summaries, historical prices, financial statements, ratios, and dividend data. Available results follow your existing SAHMK subscription, permissions, and data entitlements.
payload.longDescription: 使用您的 SAHMK 账户，直接在 ChatGPT 中访问沙特交易所市场数据。获取股票报价、企业信息、市场摘要、历史价格、财务报表、比率及股息数据。可获取的结果遵循您现有的 SAHMK 订阅、权限和数据使用授权。

payload.name: AnnuityRatesHQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research current annuity products, rates, carriers, market benchmarks, and recent rate changes. Compare products under consistent assumptions, inspect source dates and methodology, and build educational MYGA ladder scenarios. Results include citations and clearly distinguish factual research from personalized financial advice.
payload.longDescription: 研究当前年金产品、利率、保险公司、市场基准及近期利率变化。在一致假设下比较产品，查看来源日期及方法，并构建用于学习的多年保证年金（MYGA）阶梯配置情景。结果包含引用，并明确区分事实研究与个性化财务建议。

payload.name: ReInvestWealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ReInvestWealth helps businesses review and update their bookkeeping through ChatGPT, including transactions, accounts, receipts, invoices, financial reports, sales tax, automation rules, and AI bookkeeper settings.
payload.longDescription: ReInvestWealth 帮助企业通过 ChatGPT 查看和更新簿记，包括交易、账户、收据、发票、财务报告、销售税、自动化规则和 AI 记账员设置。

payload.name: Preqin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Preqin MCP connects AI assistants to Preqin data, enabling users to access and analyze information through natural language.
 
By combining AI with trusted private markets intelligence, users can research topics, answer questions, explore data, and support workflows directly within ChatGPT.
 
Preqin MCP helps bring the power of Preqin into modern AI-driven experiences.
payload.longDescription:
Preqin MCP 将 AI 助手连接至 Preqin 数据，让用户通过自然语言访问和分析信息。

将 AI 与可信赖的私募市场情报相结合，用户可直接在 ChatGPT 内研究主题、回答问题、探索数据并支持工作流。

Preqin MCP 将 Preqin 的能力带入现代 AI 驱动体验。

payload.name: Finances
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Securely connect your financial accounts to explore transactions, spending, recurring charges, investments, and liabilities in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 安全连接你的金融账户，在 ChatGPT 中探索交易、支出、定期扣费、投资和负债。

payload.name: Co-Invest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Co-Invest brings market research and portfolio planning into ChatGPT.

Explore Liquid market data, news catalysts, positioning trends, portfolio context, and trading tools in one place. Model allocations, compare opportunities, and open Liquid, our brokerage, with trade ideas ready for your final review.

Designed for traders who want sharper context, faster planning, and a more connected way to navigate Liquid markets.
payload.longDescription:
Co-Invest 将市场研究与投资组合规划带入 ChatGPT。

在一处探索 Liquid 市场数据、新闻催化因素、持仓趋势、投资组合背景和交易工具。模拟资产配置，比较机会，并打开我们的券商 Liquid，交易想法已准备好供你最终审核。

专为希望获得更清晰背景、更快规划，以及更紧密衔接方式来应对 Liquid 市场的交易者设计。

payload.name: Moody’s
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Moody’s provides GenAI-ready data including comprehensive entity data, ownership structures, financials, ratings, and research, to power advanced orchestration and multi-step analysis for credit assessment, compliance, sales intelligence, and risk monitoring. By combining Moody’s deep domain expertise and advanced AI, we deliver relevant, consistent insights for transparent, confident decision-making across evolving enterprise workflows.
payload.longDescription: Moody’s 提供适用于生成式 AI 的数据，包括全面的实体数据、所有权结构、财务数据、评级和研究，为信用评估、合规、销售情报和风险监控提供高级编排与多步骤分析能力。通过结合 Moody’s 深厚的领域专长与先进 AI，我们提供相关、一致的洞察，帮助企业在不断演变的工作流程中透明而有把握地做决策。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Entity resolution and firmographics, Credit ratings and rating history, Credit opinions, outlooks, and rating drivers, Upgrade and downgrade trigger analysis, Rating methodology and scorecard factors, ESG credit considerations, Ownership, beneficial owners, ultimate owners, and subsidiaries, Financial statements, key indicators, and ratios, Company filings search and summarization, Research document search, Earnings-call transcript search, News monitoring, Peer identification, Sector outlook and country-risk context, Managers, directors, and key officers

payload.name: Tinman AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer complex eligibility questions using trusted credit decision data and underwriting logic. Instead of navigating fragmented systems, scattered guidelines, or manual spreadsheets, users can evaluate eligibility, DTI restructuring, and income calculations across a broad set of lenders and investors, instantly identifying which investors a loan qualifies for and why. Tinman AI turns what used to take days or weeks into real-time, compliant decisions that keep loans moving and deals alive.
payload.longDescription: Tinman AI帮助贷款专员和核贷人员使用可信的信贷决策数据及核贷逻辑，快速评估住房融资情境并回答复杂的资格问题。用户无需在割裂的系统、分散的指引或手动电子表格之间奔波，而可针对广泛的贷款机构和投资者评估资格、债务收入比（DTI）重组及收入计算，即时识别贷款符合哪些投资者的条件，以及原因。Tinman AI将过去需要数天或数周的工作转为实时、合规的决策，推动贷款进程，让交易继续进行。

payload.name: ElevenFlo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ElevenFlo streamlines U.S. Chapter 11 bankruptcy and restructuring research. Search cases and court filings, browse dockets, review filing summaries, read exact document text, explore relationships among filings, and search hearing transcripts and indexed news metadata. Responses are grounded in underlying court filings and source links with verifiable citations.
payload.longDescription: ElevenFlo 简化美国《破产法》第 11 章破产和重组研究。搜索案件和法院申报文件、浏览案卷目录、查看申报摘要、阅读精确的文件原文、探索申报文件之间的关联，以及搜索庭审文字稿和已建立索引的新闻元数据。回答以底层法院申报文件和来源链接为依据，附有可核验的引用。

payload.name: Intropic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Integrate your agents into Intropic's financial information ecosystem.
payload.longDescription: 将你的智能体整合到 Intropic 的金融信息生态中。

payload.name: Bilköpskollen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bilköpskollen estimates what a used car costs to own in Sweden, not what it costs to buy. Give it a Blocket listing or the car's details and it returns the total over a chosen number of years and yearly mileage, broken down into depreciation, fuel or electricity, insurance, vehicle tax, service and repairs. It can compare two cars and say which is cheaper and by how much. Every answer links to the full report on bilkopskollen.se, where the assumptions can be changed.
payload.longDescription: Bilköpskollen 估算在瑞典持有二手车的成本，而非购车价格。提供 Blocket 挂牌信息或车辆详情，它会根据选定年数和年行驶里程返回总成本，拆分为折旧、燃油或电费、保险、车辆税、保养和维修。它可比较两辆车，说明哪辆更便宜以及相差多少。每个答案都链接到 bilkopskollen.se 上的完整报告，你可在那里调整假设。

payload.name: Instant DSCR Term Sheet
payload.description: 获取 DSCR 贷款条款清单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Request a written, indicative term sheet for a business-purpose DSCR loan on a non-owner-occupied 1–4 unit investment property, from Dominick Prevete at National Loan Provider.

Describe the deal — purchase or refinance, property address, loan amount, value, rent, taxes and insurance, credit score and how title will vest — and the app prices it against current wholesale rate sheets and program guidelines. When the deal fits, the investor receives a term sheet by email with a PDF: note rate, two origination options, monthly payment, DSCR, prepayment terms and lender fees, plus alternate loan products where available. When a deal needs a closer look, the investor is told that written terms will follow within 24 hours.

Every term sheet states the assumptions it was priced on, the rate sheet date, and when it expires. Terms are indicative and not a commitment to lend; final terms are set at rate lock.

Scope: business-purpose financing on investment property only. Owner-occupied homes and primary residences are out of scope and are not priced.

National Loan Provider (NLPI LLC) is a mortgage brokerage. It arranges business-purpose financing across 100+ third-party lenders; it is not a lender and does not make credit decisions.
payload.longDescription:
向 National Loan Provider 的 Dominick Prevete 申请书面、指示性的贷款条款清单，适用于非自住的 1–4 单元投资房产的商业用途 DSCR 贷款。

描述交易情况——购房或再融资、房产地址、贷款金额、价值、租金、税费及保险、信用评分，以及产权将登记在谁名下——应用会根据当前批发利率表和项目准则进行定价。交易符合条件时，投资者会通过电子邮件收到附 PDF 的条款清单，包含票面利率、两种贷款发起方案、月供、DSCR、提前还款条款和贷款机构费用，并在有条件时列出其他贷款产品。交易需要进一步审查时，会告知投资者将在 24 小时内提供书面条款。

每份条款清单均注明定价所依据的假设、利率表日期及到期时间。条款仅具指示性，不构成放贷承诺；最终条款在锁定利率时确定。

适用范围：仅限投资房产的商业用途融资。自住房及主要居所不在适用范围内，不予定价。

National Loan Provider（NLPI LLC）是房贷经纪公司，通过 100+ 家第三方贷款机构安排商业用途融资；它不是贷款机构，也不作信用审批决定。

payload.name: Tapusor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tapusor, Türkiye gayrimenkul piyasası için değerleme, analiz ve portföy yönetimi asistanıdır. Kendi Tapusor hesabınızla (OAuth) giriş yaptıktan sonra şunları yapabilirsiniz:

• Değerleme & piyasa: Bir konum için tahmini satılık/kiralık m² değeri, yakındaki gerçek ilanlar, bölgesel piyasa trendi, parsel/kadastro bilgisi, yatırım analizi ve nokta bazlı risk.
• Bilgi Al: Teknik durum/kısıtlılık, imar planları, bölge havadis, resmi satışlar (TKGM), sosyo-ekonomik veriler, yakındaki danışmanlar, Milli Emlak fırsatları; favorileriniz ve gezdikleriniz.
• Konum çözümleme: Ada-parsel, koordinat, adres veya ilan no ile kesin parsel bulma.
• Raporlar: Konut/İşyeri/Arsa/Elit/Emsal + İnnBroker/Varlık/Fırsat raporları oluşturma; mevcut raporun içeriğini okuma; raporu veya hazırlanan bir tabloyu mail/WhatsApp ile kendinize gönderme.
• Varlık Yönetimi: Portföy panosu (değer/trend/teknik-plan/pazar potansiyeli), varlık listesi ve tek varlık detayı (emsal karşılaştırma, pazar göstergeleri, yatırım skoru, teknik riskler).

Veriler yalnızca sizin kendi hesabınıza aittir; başka kullanıcıların verisine erişilmez. Yazma işlemleri (rapor oluşturma, gönderim) onay ister.
payload.longDescription:
Tapusor 是面向土耳其房地产市场的估值、分析与资产组合管理助手。使用自己的 Tapusor 账户通过 OAuth 登录后，你可以：

• 估值与市场：查询某地点出售/出租的每 m² 估算价值、附近真实挂牌信息、区域市场趋势、地块/地籍信息、投资分析和具体地点的风险。
• 获取信息：查询技术状况/限制、规划方案、地区新闻、官方销售记录（TKGM）、社会经济数据、附近顾问、Milli Emlak 国有房地产机会，以及收藏和浏览记录。
• 位置解析：通过街区与地块编号、坐标、地址或挂牌编号定位准确地块。
• 报告：生成住宅/商业物业/土地/高端/可比物业以及 İnnBroker/资产/机会报告；阅读已有报告内容；通过邮件或 WhatsApp 将报告或整理的表格发送给自己。
• 资产管理：查看资产组合面板（价值/趋势/技术与规划/市场潜力）、资产列表和单项资产详情（可比物业对照、市场指标、投资评分、技术风险）。

数据仅来自你自己的账户，不会访问其他用户的数据。写入操作（创建报告、发送）需要确认批准。

payload.name: Retirement Lab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Retirement Lab runs hypothetical retirement projections from user-supplied financial, tax-residence, and market assumptions. It can save and compare scenarios, run parameter sweeps, inspect stored results, render projection summaries, preview selected taxes, and create unlisted public shares on explicit request.
payload.longDescription: Retirement Lab 根据用户提供的财务、税务居民身份及市场假设，运行假设性的退休预测。它可保存和比较情景、运行参数扫描、查看已存储结果、呈现预测摘要、预览选定税项，并在明确请求时创建不公开列出的公开分享。

payload.name: Suitoly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Suitoly is a simple income and expense tracker with cloud sync. Connect it to ChatGPT to search, record, and summarize your finances in natural language.

What you can do:
- List the ledgers you have allowed ChatGPT to use
- Search entries by keyword, date range, amount, or category
- Record a new income or expense entry
- Generate a report with monthly and category breakdowns

You stay in control of your data. When you connect, Suitoly asks you to sign in and choose exactly which ledgers ChatGPT can access, and whether it can only read or also add entries. You can review and disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Settings > API Tokens in the Suitoly app, and access stops immediately.

Suitoly also supports multiple ledgers for different purposes, sharing with family or friends, and receipt scanning.

A Suitoly account is required. Get the app:
- iPhone / iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790985695
- Web: https://app.suitoly.com
payload.longDescription:
Suitoly 是一款支持云同步的简易收支记录工具。连接 ChatGPT 后，你可用自然语言搜索、记录和汇总财务。

你可以：
- 列出已授权 ChatGPT 使用的账本
- 按关键词、日期范围、金额或类别搜索记录
- 记录一笔新的收入或支出
- 生成按月份和类别拆分的报告

数据始终由你掌控。连接时，Suitoly 会要求登录，并让你明确选择 ChatGPT 可访问哪些账本，以及仅能读取还是也能新增记录。你可随时在 Suitoly 应用的 Settings > API Tokens 中查看并断开 ChatGPT，访问权限会立即停止。

Suitoly 还支持为不同用途创建多个账本、与家人或朋友共享，以及扫描收据。

需要 Suitoly 账户。获取应用：
- iPhone / iPad：https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790985695
- 网页版：https://app.suitoly.com

payload.name: Canary Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate new investment ideas and perform in-depth analysis of any publicly traded business using proprietary Canary datasets, intelligence and synthesis within ChatGPT/Codex. Canary plays well with other financial MCPs to combine to make ChatGPT/Codex into a world-class investment analyst.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT／Codex 中，利用 Canary 专有数据集、情报及综合分析生成新投资思路，并深入分析任意上市企业。Canary 可与其他金融 MCP 良好配合，共同将 ChatGPT／Codex 打造成世界级投资分析师。

payload.name: Dineo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dineo helps users review balances, cash flow, categories, counterparties, movements, and transfers in their authenticated account. It displays financial charts and, only on explicit request, creates or modifies Dineo records and validates movement batches before import. Dineo records financial activity but does not move money, execute payments, transfer crypto assets, or perform investment trades.
payload.longDescription: Dineo 帮助用户查看其已认证账户中的余额、现金流、类别、交易对手、资金变动及转账。它展示财务图表，并且仅在明确要求时创建或修改 Dineo 记录，以及在导入前验证资金变动批次。Dineo 记录财务活动，但不会转移资金、执行付款、转移加密资产或进行投资交易。

payload.name: Instant Books
payload.description: 向 AI 记账助手提问
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instant Books is AI bookkeeping for small businesses. Connect your Instant Books company and ask about spending by vendor or category, cash position, unpaid bills, overdue invoices, bank transactions and the profit and loss - the same questions the AI Bookkeeper answers in the portal. Restaurants can also record a Toast or DoorDash payout as a posted journal entry: sales, tax, tips and fees on the accounts the company confirmed on its Integrations page. The app reads your books and records entries; it never moves money, pays anyone or changes what is already booked, and a payout recorded twice is refused.
payload.longDescription: Instant Books 为小企业提供 AI 记账。连接你的 Instant Books 公司账户，询问按供应商或类别划分的支出、现金状况、未付账单、逾期发票、银行交易及损益，这些与门户中的 AI Bookkeeper 回答的问题相同。餐厅还可将 Toast 或 DoorDash 结算款记录为已过账日记账分录：销售额、税款、小费和费用分别记入公司在 Integrations 页面确认的科目。应用读取账簿并记录分录；绝不转移资金、向任何人付款或更改已记账内容，同一笔结算款重复记录会被拒绝。

payload.name: Finology Software
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare every federal repayment plan a loan can elect, estimate a Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) payment, and compare filing jointly against filing separately, using the same engine Finology Software advisors use for client plans. Figures follow the current federal rules, including the changes in effect since July 1, 2026, and each result states the rule version and date it used. Plans a borrower cannot elect are listed with the rule that excludes them.

Advisors with a Finology Software account can link it to list their clients, run a projection on a client's imported federal loan file, and chart each plan's balance year by year. Client names can be withheld and replaced with initials.

Results are estimates for education, not financial, legal or tax advice.
payload.longDescription:
比较贷款可选择的每一种联邦还款计划，估算还款援助计划（RAP）的付款额，并比较联合报税与分别报税，使用与 Finology Software 顾问为客户制定计划相同的引擎。数字遵循现行联邦规则，包括自 July 1, 2026（2026 年 7 月 1 日）起生效的变化，每个结果都会说明使用的规则版本和日期。借款人不能选择的计划会一并列出，并说明将其排除的规则。

拥有 Finology Software 账户的顾问可以连接账户以列出客户，对客户导入的联邦贷款文件进行预测，并绘制各计划逐年的余额图表。可隐藏客户姓名并用姓名首字母替代。

结果是用于教育的估算，不属于财务、法律或税务建议。

payload.name: 1st Private Capital
payload.description: 硬资产抵押与 DSCR 贷款报价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Price a real-estate investment loan without leaving the conversation. 1st Private Capital is a direct private lender for real estate investors: bridge and hard money loans, fix and flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental loans, and commercial, mixed-use and equity-based term loans, in 40 states.

Describe the property and the loan. You get the program that fits, the most you can borrow and what limits it, an indicative rate and monthly payment, points and costs, as a quote card in the chat. When the numbers work, request a term sheet and it goes straight to the lending desk.

Business-purpose loans on investment and commercial real estate only. Not for a home you will live in, and not for personal, family or household use. Every figure is an indicative estimate, not a commitment to lend. All loans are subject to underwriting. 1st Private Capital, Inc., California DRE Real Estate Corporation License #02254322.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话，即可获取房地产投资贷款报价。1st Private Capital 是直接面向房地产投资者的私人贷款机构，在 40 个州提供过桥贷款、硬资产抵押贷款、翻修转售贷款、新建项目贷款、DSCR 出租物业贷款，以及商业物业、混合用途物业和基于权益的定期贷款。

描述物业和贷款需求，即可在聊天中的报价卡上看到适合的方案、最高可借金额及限制因素、参考利率与月供、贷款点数费用及其他成本。如果这些数字符合需求，可申请条款清单，申请将直接送到贷款业务团队。

仅提供用于投资和商业房地产的商业用途贷款。不适用于自住住宅，也不适用于个人、家庭或家居用途。所有数字均为参考估算，不构成放贷承诺。所有贷款均须经过承保审核。1st Private Capital, Inc.，加利福尼亚州 DRE 房地产公司许可证 #02254322。

payload.name: PrimeSync AI Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn your own trading idea into a structured Pine Script v6 or Python strategy blueprint. Audit generated code against approved rules and run deterministic Monte Carlo robustness checks on chronological backtest returns. PrimeSync Studio does not execute trades, provide personalized financial advice, or guarantee profitability.
payload.longDescription: 将您的交易理念转化为结构化的Pine Script v6或Python策略蓝图。根据批准的规则审核生成的代码，并对时间序列回测收益进行确定性蒙特卡洛鲁棒性测试。PrimeSync Studio不执行交易、不提供个性化财务建议，也不保证盈利能力。

payload.name: Mollie
payload.description: 构建 Mollie 支付流程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects Codex to your Mollie account through the Mollie MCP server and adds skills for building Mollie integrations: hosted checkout and Components, Mollie Connect for platforms and marketplaces, recurring payments and subscriptions, refunds, captures, chargebacks and settlements, webhook and credential troubleshooting, SDK upgrades, and AI agents built on the Mollie agent toolkit.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Mollie MCP 服务器将 Codex 连接到 Mollie 账户，并添加构建 Mollie 集成的技能：托管结账和 Components、适用于平台及市场的 Mollie Connect、定期付款和订阅、退款、请款、拒付和结算、webhook 与凭据排障、SDK 升级，以及基于 Mollie agent toolkit 构建的 AI 智能体。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build Mollie payment integrations, Set up Mollie Connect for platforms, Implement recurring payments and subscriptions, Review payments, refunds and settlements, Troubleshoot webhooks and authentication, Upgrade Mollie SDKs and migrate from the Orders API

payload.name: PortfolIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your PortfolIQ account to review holdings, realized and unrealized performance, transaction history, trading activity, and factual account alerts. Explore saved strategies, run historical simulations, and review position plans. With the permissions you grant, record or correct transactions, manage portfolios, and save strategies and retrospective reviews. Transaction tools record trades in your tracker; brokerage order execution is not supported. Historical simulations are not predictions of future returns. A PortfolIQ account is required, and some features depend on your account plan.
payload.longDescription: 连接 PortfolIQ 账户，查看持仓、已实现和未实现表现、交易历史、交易活动，以及基于事实的账户提醒。探索已保存的策略，运行历史模拟，并查看持仓计划。在你授予的权限内，记录或更正交易、管理投资组合、保存策略与复盘。交易工具仅将交易记录到追踪器中，不支持券商订单执行。历史模拟不代表未来收益预测。需要 PortfolIQ 账户，部分功能取决于账户套餐。

payload.name: ABG Market Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access read-only crypto market evidence from ABG across supported exchanges. Compare venues, inspect liquidity and order-book walls, review execution flow, open interest, funding, data freshness, and coverage. ABG helps ChatGPT analyze market conditions using structured multi-exchange data. It does not place trades or execute transactions.
payload.longDescription: 通过支持的交易所访问ABG提供的只读加密货币市场数据。比较交易场所，查看流动性及订单簿挂单墙，审查成交流向、未平仓合约、资金费率、数据新鲜度和覆盖范围。ABG通过结构化的多交易所数据帮助ChatGPT分析市场状况。该工具不进行交易或执行操作。

payload.name: Gemral Edge
payload.description: 公共记录中的市场信号
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gemral Edge provides public-record financial intelligence inside ChatGPT. It covers congressional stock trades, U.S. federal and defense contracts, lobbying activity, management commitment history, upcoming market catalysts, prediction-market odds, and cross-signal convergence. Results depend on subscription tier and are informational only, not investment advice.

Who's trading and who's winning money: congressional stock trades (who in Congress is buying or selling, STOCK Act disclosures, a trading leaderboard, any lawmaker's history), U.S. federal & Pentagon defense contract awards, corporate lobbying-spend velocity, AI tech-infrastructure shifts, and FED system liquidity — cross-referenced onto the same ticker and ranked by an Alpha Score where signals converge.

Does management keep its word: the Management Track Record engine scores whether a company's executives actually deliver on the commitments they make on earnings calls and in filings — an Executive Reliability / Credibility score, realization rate, time accuracy, promise-execution timeline, and language-drift/contradiction alerts (and it follows executives across companies).

What's about to move the market: a Breakout Watch / catalyst radar of upcoming market-moving events — drug-approval decisions, regulatory and enforcement actions, appropriations and contract deadlines, executive orders and policy shifts — each with a breakout score and expected-impact scenarios, plus prediction-market odds and historical resolution precedents.

Example asks: "top convergence signals in defense right now", "the congressional trading leaderboard this quarter", "which companies just won federal contracts", "does NVDA management keep its promises", "what catalysts are coming up for biotech this month", "the 2026 Senate battleground", or "screen for tickers where congressional buying, contract wins, and lobbying all line up".

Results are served at your subscription tier (a free tier is available; upgrade for full unmasked signals, the Alpha Score, catalyst radar, and alerts). All data is derived from public records and is informational only — not investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
Gemral Edge 在 ChatGPT 内提供基于公共记录的金融情报，涵盖国会议员股票交易、美国联邦及国防合同、游说活动、管理层承诺兑现历史、即将出现的市场催化因素、预测市场赔率，以及多类信号的交汇。结果取决于订阅档位，仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

谁在交易、谁在赚钱：国会议员股票交易（哪些议员正在买卖、《STOCK 法案》披露、交易排行榜、任意议员的历史记录）、美国联邦及五角大楼国防合同授予、企业游说支出的变化速度、AI 技术基础设施变化，以及美联储系统流动性——将这些信号交叉关联到同一股票代码，并在信号交汇处按 Alpha Score 排名。

管理层是否说到做到：Management Track Record 引擎评估公司高管是否真正兑现业绩电话会和申报文件中的承诺，提供高管可靠性／可信度评分、兑现率、时间准确度、承诺执行时间线，以及措辞偏移／前后矛盾警报（还会跨公司跟踪高管）。

什么即将推动市场：Breakout Watch／催化因素雷达追踪即将影响市场的事件，包括药品审批决定、监管与执法行动、拨款及合同截止日期、行政命令和政策变化。每项事件均附突破评分和预期影响情景，并提供预测市场赔率及历史结果先例。

提问示例：“当前国防行业最强的交汇信号”“本季度国会议员交易排行榜”“哪些公司刚拿到联邦合同”“NVDA 管理层是否兑现承诺”“本月生物科技行业有哪些催化因素”“2026 年参议院关键争夺选区”，或“筛选国会议员买入、合同中标和游说活动相互印证的股票”。

结果按你的订阅档位提供（有免费档位；升级可查看完整、未遮蔽的信号、Alpha Score、催化因素雷达及警报）。所有数据均源于公共记录，仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

payload.name: Gasti
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gasti helps you review and maintain your personal financial records through your connected account. List, record, edit and delete income and expenses; manage account records and categories; record transfers already made between your accounts; and review income and expense reports by currency, account and category. Gasti does not hold funds, initiate payments or exchange currencies. Account numbers or aliases and the last four card digits are optional account metadata. When analytics is enabled, tool calls record the user and OAuth client identifiers, tool name, outcome and duration; transaction inputs and results are not included in those usage events.
payload.longDescription: Gasti 帮助你通过已连接的账户查看和维护个人财务记录。列出、记录、编辑和删除收入与支出；管理账户记录及类别；记录已经在自己的账户之间完成的转账；按币种、账户和类别查看收支报告。Gasti 不持有资金、不发起付款，也不兑换货币。账户号码或别名以及银行卡后四位可作为可选账户元数据。启用分析时，工具调用会记录用户及 OAuth 客户端标识、工具名称、结果和耗时；这些使用事件不包含交易输入和结果。

payload.name: InvoiceIQ by Analytos Labs
payload.description: AI应付账款（AP）与应收账款（AR）发票自动化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: InvoiceIQ turns supplier invoices into coded, verified, ERP-ready vendor bills. In ChatGPT you can upload an invoice PDF, follow its processing, read the extracted header and GL-coded lines, ask why a line was coded the way it was, check the purchase-order match report, and run plain-English spend questions across your invoice history. When an invoice is complete and matched you can post it as a vendor bill: InvoiceIQ shows the exact bill first and posts only after you confirm. All data is scoped to your organization and role and every action is audited. Works with NetSuite and a generic ERP connector.
payload.longDescription: InvoiceIQ可将供应商发票转化为已编码、已验证且适配ERP系统的供应商账单。在ChatGPT中您可以上传发票PDF文件，跟踪处理进度，查看提取的发票头信息和总账编码行，询问某一行被如此编码的原因，检查采购订单匹配报告，并对历史发票数据运行自然语言支出查询。当发票处理完成并完成匹配后，可将其作为供应商账单发布：InvoiceIQ会先显示精确的账单，确认后才进行发布。所有数据范围仅限于您的组织和角色，每项操作都会被审计。支持NetSuite及通用ERP连接器。

payload.name: De Belegger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View your De Belegger investment portfolios, watchlists and transaction history in ChatGPT. See your positions, cash, portfolio weights and returns, and search your own records by name or ticker. You can also prepare a transaction draft. You confirm or reject the draft in De Belegger before it is recorded.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中查看您的De Belegger投资组合、自选清单和交易记录。查看您的持仓、现金、组合权重和收益，并可通过名称或代码搜索您的交易记录。您还可以创建交易草稿。在记录之前，您可在De Belegger中确认或拒绝该草稿。

payload.name: IndicadoresChilenos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consulta valores actuales e históricos desde 2020 de UF, UTM, dólar, IPC, TPM y libra de cobre. Las consultas múltiples mantienen los resultados disponibles aunque un indicador no pueda obtenerse, y cada respuesta incluye la fecha de consulta y un aviso de información referencial.
payload.longDescription: 查询2020年以来的UF、UTM、美元、IPC、TPM和铜价的实时及历史数据。多指标查询功能在单个指标无法获取时仍可保留其他结果，每次查询结果均包含查询日期和参考信息声明。

payload.name: FinalPeace
payload.description: 遗嘱规则与丧后检查清单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FinalPeace helps families write a will, power of attorney and healthcare directive, and keep them in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT three tools anyone can use without an account.

State document requirements. For any of the 50 states, it looks up what it takes to sign a will, a financial power of attorney, a health care proxy or a living will: how many witnesses, whether a notary is needed, who can't serve as a witness, and whether the state publishes an official form. Every answer shows the date it was last checked and the source it was checked against.

After-a-loss checklist. The practical list of what needs doing after someone dies, grouped by when it matters: the first 24 to 48 hours, the first week, the first month, and ongoing.

Planning check. Tell it what you already have, such as a will, a healthcare agent or a power of attorney, and it ranks what's missing by what would go wrong without it. Anything you haven't answered comes back as a question.

If you already have a FinalPeace account, a fourth tool explains how to connect it.

FinalPeace is not a law firm and doesn't give legal advice. State rules change, so check the date on each answer and confirm anything important with your state or a lawyer.
payload.longDescription:
FinalPeace帮助家庭起草遗嘱、授权书和医疗指示，并将它们集中存放。此插件为ChatGPT提供三项工具，任何人都可无需账户直接使用。

查询各州文件要求。针对美国50个州中的任意一个，可查询起草遗嘱、财务授权书、医疗代理或生前遗嘱所需条件：需要多少见证人、是否需要公证人、哪些人不能担任见证人，以及该州是否提供官方模板。每个答案都会显示最后核查日期及核查来源。

丧后操作检查清单。列出人员去世后需要处理的事项，按关键时间节点分类：最初24至48小时、第一周、第一个月及持续进行的事项。

规划检查。告知系统您已有的文件，例如遗嘱、医疗代理人或授权书，系统会根据缺失文件可能引发的问题严重性进行排序。任何未填写的信息都会以问题形式返回。

如果您已有FinalPeace账户，第四项工具可说明如何进行账户关联。

FinalPeace并非律师事务所，也不提供法律建议。各州法规可能变更，请核对每个答案的日期，并通过当地机构或律师确认重要信息。

payload.name: finerd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
finerd lets you explore and manage your finances directly in ChatGPT.

Analyze your money: “How much did I spend on food last month?”, “Which category takes the biggest share of my expenses?”, “Which credit card fits my spending best?”

Take action on transactions: “Tag all transactions from April 10–18 as Milan trip”, “Move Netflix from Entertainment to Subscriptions”, “Find the duplicate restaurant charge from last week.”

Plan scenarios: “Can I afford a one-year sabbatical?”, “How would moving to another city affect my finances?”, “What would buying a home do to my cash flow and net worth?”
payload.longDescription:
finerd 让您可以直接在 ChatGPT 中探索和管理您的财务。

分析您的资金：「上个月我在食物上花了多少钱？」，「哪个类别占我支出的最大比例？」，「哪种信用卡最符合我的消费习惯？」

处理交易操作：「将4月10日至18日的所有交易标记为米兰旅行」，「将 Netflix 从娱乐移到订阅」，「查找上周重复的餐厅消费记录。」

规划财务场景：「我负担得起一年的休假吗？」，「搬到另一个城市会如何影响我的财务状况？」，「买房会对我的现金流和净资产产生什么影响？」

payload.name: Halan Borsa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Halan Borsa helps users research Egyptian Exchange stocks, review live and historical market data, inspect their brokerage holdings, and create draft limit orders for confirmation in the Halan Borsa app.
payload.longDescription: Halan Borsa帮助用户研究埃及证券交易所股票，查看实时和历史市场数据，检查其经纪账户持仓，并创建草案限价订单以在Halan Borsa应用中确认。

payload.name: PhillipCapital Türkiye
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
See Borsa Istanbul in ChatGPT with your Phillip Capital account. Ask for live equity and derivatives prices, bid/ask depth, and the day's top gainers and losers from the brokerage's own feed. Read Phillip Capital research and PhillipMind symbol summaries. View your own positions, cash, trading limits and the status of today's orders.

Every price reply states whether the data is realtime or delayed and the time it was taken. This app is information only and does not place, change or cancel orders. Phillip Capital customers place orders through the firm's own channels, including MobilG and Phillip Capital's separate order connector for AI assistants, which is offered directly by the brokerage under its own customer agreement.
payload.longDescription:
通过Phillip Capital账户在ChatGPT中查看伊斯坦布尔证券交易所行情。
查询实时股票和衍生品价格、买卖盘深度，以及经纪商自有数据源提供的当日涨跌幅榜。
阅读Phillip Capital研究报告和PhillipMind符号摘要。
查看您的持仓、现金余额、交易限额及今日订单状态。

每条价格信息会注明数据是实时或延迟的，并显示获取时间。
本应用仅提供信息参考，不支持下单、修改或取消订单。
Phillip Capital客户需通过公司自有渠道下单，包括MobilG应用及Phillip Capital为AI助手提供的独立订单连接器，该连接器由经纪商直接通过客户协议提供。

payload.name: Dubai Wealth Index Real Estate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dubai Wealth Index answers what Dubai homes sell for, rent for and yield, from registered records rather than listings. Figures are medians of Dubai Land Department sale transactions and Ejari rental contracts, published per apartment building, per area and per villa community, and date-stamped by data edition.

Ask about one building by its registered or marketing name, or get a full report on it covering every unit size, growth with both comparison periods, and each figure that was withheld for lack of evidence. Filter the whole index on your own thresholds (price band, minimum gross yield, minimum evidence), compare two to four buildings on matching bedroom types, read a published ranking, inspect the individual transactions behind a median, test an agent's claimed yield against registered records, and see what changed in your saved buildings since an earlier edition. Every figure comes with its bedroom type, unit, period, data date and evidence count.

Built for investors, buyers, tenants, analysts and journalists who need a sourced Dubai property figure.

Limitations: Dubai only. Yields are gross, before service charges and other costs. Short-term rental returns are modelled from a stated occupancy assumption, not measured. Villas are published by community, not individually. The index holds no listings, cannot arrange viewings, and does not give investment, mortgage, tax or legal advice. Every tool is read-only. Connecting requires a Dubai Wealth Index account, which also lets the plugin read the buildings you have saved on dubaiwealthindex.com.
payload.longDescription:
迪拜财富指数通过官方记录而非房源信息，揭示迪拜房产的成交价、租金水平和投资回报率。数据源自迪拜土地局的销售交易和Ejari租赁合同的中位数，按公寓楼、区域和别墅社区分类发布，并标注数据版本日期。

可通过官方名称或营销名称查询单栋建筑信息，或获取涵盖所有户型尺寸、对比周期内的增长情况，以及因证据不足未公开的各项数据的完整报告。自定义价格区间、最低毛回报率和最低证据标准筛选整个指数，对比2-4栋建筑的同户型配置，查阅已发布的排名榜单，查看中位数对应的单笔交易记录，验证中介宣称的回报率与官方记录的一致性，追踪已保存建筑在历版数据中的变化情况。所有数据均附带户型、单元、统计周期、数据日期和证据数量说明。

专为需要获取迪拜房产权威数据的投资者、购房者、租户、分析师和记者设计。

限制条件：仅限迪拜地区。回报率计算为毛收益，未扣除服务费等其他成本。短期租赁收益基于设定的入住率假设进行模型测算，而非实际数据。别墅数据按社区汇总，不单独列示。该指数不包含房源信息，无法安排看房，也不提供投资、按揭、税务或法律建议。所有工具均为只读模式。连接需使用迪拜财富指数账户，该账户还可使插件读取用户在dubaiwealthindex.com上保存的建筑信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Building prices, rents and gross yields, Full building reports with growth evidence, Area and villa community records, Screen and compare buildings, Check a yield claim against registered records, Transactions behind each median, Your saved buildings and what changed

payload.name: SPACInsider
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SPACInsider gives ChatGPT read-only access to SPACInsider's SPAC database: the current SPAC universe with IPO terms, trust values, deadlines and redemption data; point-in-time historical snapshots of the market on any past date; sponsor, underwriter, advisor and investor relationships; IPO, de-SPAC, PIPE, private placement, serial sponsor and 13F league tables; corporate actions such as extension and completion votes and liquidations; lockup and earnout terms; terminated deals; and SEC 13F filings and holdings. Typical workflows: count or screen SPACs by IPO date, status or deal terms; compare the market today with a past date; look up one SPAC's profile, participants and history; rank underwriters, advisors or investors over a date window; and aggregate trust, proceeds or redemption statistics. Every tool queries SPACInsider's own database and returns structured data; nothing is written, sent or fetched from the public internet. A SPACInsider account with MCP access is required.
payload.longDescription:
SPACInsider为ChatGPT提供只读访问权限，可查询SPACInsider的SPAC数据库：当前SPAC全貌包含IPO条款、信托价值、截止日期及赎回数据；任意历史日期的市场快照；发起人、承销商、顾问和投资者关系网络；IPO、反向并购、PIPE、私募配售、连续发起人及13F排行榜；公司行为如延期投票和完成投票及清算；锁定期和对赌条款；终止交易记录以及SEC 13F文件和持仓信息。
典型工作流包括：按IPO日期、状态或交易条款筛选SPAC；将当前市场与历史日期对比；查询单个SPAC的档案、参与方及历史记录；在指定时间窗口内对承销商、顾问或投资者进行排名；聚合信托、募资或赎回统计数据。
每个工具均查询SPACInsider自有数据库并返回结构化数据；不会从公共互联网写入、发送或获取任何内容。
需要拥有MCP权限的SPACInsider账户。

payload.name: Momentum
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Momentum brings Polish private equity data into ChatGPT: the companies, who owns and backs them, their financials, competitors, trading peers multiples.

Describe the companies you want in a sentence, such as "Polish software companies with an EBITDA margin above 20%", and get the list with revenue, margins and ownership. Ask for any company's financials, its closest competitors, its market's operating benchmarks, or a valuation from listed comparables.
